tools.name: salesnow_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts records in SalesNOW, one page at a time. Reply: item_list (records) and total_count. Use modified_from and modified_to to limit the window. GET /models/contacts.

tools.name: salesnow_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact record by id, with all its fields. GET /models/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: salesnow_get_metadata
tools.description: List the field names, types and custom fields of one record type. Use it before a create or update call. GET /models/{model}/metadata.

tools.name: salesnow_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in SalesNOW from the given fields. This adds a record that the team can see. PUT /models/contacts.

tools.name: salesnow_update_contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one existing contact. Fields you leave out keep their values. POST /models/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: salesnow_create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task in SalesNOW from the given fields (for example a title and a due date). PUT /models/tasks.

tools.name: salesnow_update_task
tools.description: Change the given fields of one existing task, for example to mark it done. Fields you leave out keep their values. POST /models/tasks/{id}.
